ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface with a high-intensity white pixel ratio of approximately 5-10% localized to focal scar clusters and fringe highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey to black base pigmentation with distinct white/grey circular and elliptical high-contrast clusters concentrated in the lower central region and lower-left lobe; localized white pixel clusters also present along the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a sharp, well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, irregular serrations; the right lobe exhibits more pronounced sawtooth-like peaks with higher pixel amplitude compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering into acute, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular and annular white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle scarring) distributed across the lower medial surface and extending into the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular/annular scarring across the visible ventral surface; irregular textural growth or calcification visible on the far distal edges of both tips.
